d:
“It’s me. Youko… Allow me to apologise for what happened that day.”

Youko, a beautiful and alluring woman,
appears before a man who has grown frustrated with his mundane life. Before she leaves, she hands him a business card.

Drawn in by the invitation, he makes his way to “Funny Garden,” the establishment
listed on the card. And waiting there to greet him is none other than the Youko he met that day…

But this time, she is dressed as a stunning and seductive bunny girl,
her glamorous figure accentuated to perfection?!
